scripts.build: npm run typecheck:firebase && npm run build:firebase
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run test && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 deploy --only firestore,hosting
scripts.deploy:firebase:central: npm run test && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 deploy --only hosting:central --config firebase.central-hosting.json --project digital-corps-badge-tracker
scripts.deploy:firebase:short: npm run test && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 deploy --only hosting:short --config firebase.short-hosting.json --project digital-corps-badge-tracker
scripts.test: npm run test:availability && npm run build
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 emulators:exec --project digital-corps-badge-tracker-rules-test --only firestore "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
